stories.title: « Je m’étais promis de ne pas pleurer, je ne tiens pas mes promesses » : Céline Dion revient sur scène devant Paris et le monde

en.title: "I had promised myself not to cry, I'm not keeping my promises": Céline Dion returns to the stage before Paris and the world
en.summary: Céline Dion performed her first concert in six years on Saturday evening in Paris after a health-related absence, appearing before an audience of fans and celebrities.

en.title: Céline Dion performs "My Heart Will Go On" at her first concert in Paris
en.summary: Céline Dion visibly emotional, began her first of 26 concerts near Paris on Saturday evening, marking her return after more than six years away, performing her "Titanic" theme song.

en.title: Céline Dion Moved by Return to Stage in Paris After More Than Six Years Away
